name: BSC Target Trend, net revenue, branch 6, ending 2026-08, has 12 months
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", LEN(CALCULATE([BSC Target Trend], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "FIN_NET_REVENUE", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608)) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE(CALCULATE([BSC Target Trend], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "FIN_NET_REVENUE", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608), ";", "")) + 1)
sql: select 12

name: BSC Target Trend, net revenue, branch 6, ending 2026-08, last value equals BSC Target
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VALUE(MID(CALCULATE([BSC Target Trend], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "FIN_NET_REVENUE", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608), FIND("|", SUBSTITUTE(CALCULATE([BSC Target Trend], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "FIN_NET_REVENUE", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608), ";", "|", 11)) + 1, 40)) - CALCULATE([BSC Target], 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = "FIN_NET_REVENUE", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608))
sql: select 0

name: BSC Visual Pillar Score equals BSC Pillar Score on the pillar's first row, Financial, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR t = CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('BSC KPI'[KPI Code], 'BSC KPI'[Pillar], "@v", [BSC Visual Pillar Score], "@n", COUNTROWS('BSC KPI')), Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608) VAR x = ADDCOLUMNS(t, "@min", VAR p = 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] RETURN MINX(FILTER(t, 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] = p), 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code])) VAR fin = FILTER(x, 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] = "Financial" && 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = [@min]) RETURN INT(COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]) <> ('BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = [@min]))) = 0 && COUNTROWS(fin) = 1 && ABS(SUMX(fin, [@v]) - CALCULATE([BSC Pillar Score], 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] = "Financial", Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608)) < 0.000001))
sql: select 1

name: BSC Visual Pillar Score is blank on every other row
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR t = CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('BSC KPI'[KPI Code], 'BSC KPI'[Pillar], "@v", [BSC Visual Pillar Score], "@n", COUNTROWS('BSC KPI')), Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608) VAR x = ADDCOLUMNS(t, "@min", VAR p = 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] RETURN MINX(FILTER(t, 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] = p), 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code])) RETURN IF(COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]) <> ('BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = [@min]))) = 0 && COUNTROWS(x) > COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]))), COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]))), -1))
sql: select uniqExact(pillar) from gold.ssas_dim_bsc_kpi

name: BSC Visual Overall Score equals BSC Overall Score, branch 6, 2026-08
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR t = CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('BSC KPI'[KPI Code], 'BSC KPI'[Pillar], "@v", [BSC Visual Overall Score], "@n", COUNTROWS('BSC KPI')), Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608) VAR x = ADDCOLUMNS(t, "@min", MINX(t, 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code])) RETURN INT(COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]) <> ('BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = [@min]))) = 0 && COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]))) = 1 && ABS(SUMX(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v])), [@v]) - CALCULATE([BSC Overall Score], Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608)) < 0.000001))
sql: select 1

name: BSC Visual Pillar Trend has 12 months on the first row
dax: EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR t = CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('BSC KPI'[KPI Code], 'BSC KPI'[Pillar], "@v", [BSC Visual Pillar Trend], "@n", COUNTROWS('BSC KPI')), Branch[Branch Key] = 6, 'Date'[Year Month] = 202608) VAR x = ADDCOLUMNS(t, "@min", VAR p = 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] RETURN MINX(FILTER(t, 'BSC KPI'[Pillar] = p), 'BSC KPI'[KPI Code])) RETURN INT(COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]) <> ('BSC KPI'[KPI Code] = [@min]))) = 0 && COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]))) = 4 && COUNTROWS(FILTER(x, NOT ISBLANK([@v]) && LEN([@v]) - LEN(SUBSTITUTE([@v], ";", "")) = 11)) = 4) * 12)
sql: select 12
